headline: Violent Northern Clashes Intensify as Frontline Hexes Suffer Heavy Losses
war_summary: Searing combat along the northern belt and central riverlands has escalated sharply over the past three hours, driving mounting butcher's bills across multiple contested sectors. Mooring County and Callum's Cape remain the premier cauldrons of the war, where casualty rates accelerated rapidly over the last two hours as both sides threw fresh drafts into grinding struggles around The Wind Hills, Gravekeeper's Holdfast, Naofa, and Scout's Jest. Weathered Expanse and Linn of Mercy likewise sustained relentless pressure, logging six and three strategic base transitions respectively in the latest two-hour window amid fierce assaults on Crow's Nest and Outwich Ranch. Further east, Checkpoint Bua in Marban Hollow changed hands repeatedly with three fresh events, while an unexpected island flare-up in Lykos Isle produced five rapid exchanges between Fort Guile and The Squall. Conversely, previously active sectors like Stonecradle and Nevish Line have remained entirely dormant through the afternoon.
